Strict CS2 silhouette target 0.90 is not yet met; epoch 8 trigger loop 2 masks are 0.8105 front and 0.7984 back after enlarging the source-only crown decal on the objective bell while preserving the locked receiver-parented bolt.

Scope-only review: optic span and taper now fit the 500x180 reference crop; rings, turret, marking, crown, and shortened rail are separate attached real components. Clamp machining and hidden underside thickness remain procedural approximations.

Loop 3 attachment repair: fasteners and ejection-port hardware were moved back onto the receiver/stock side surfaces after the top view exposed z=±0.44 floaters; the crown is now a conformed thin decal plus restrained gold overlay; the compact trigger and telescoping bipod remain attached. Visual review still finds trigger proportions, crown artwork scale, bipod silhouette, and global proportions below 0.90.
Medusa paint is a shell-only curved projection from supplied pixels; it is not used as structural geometry.
